personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly functional logistics tool that strips away noise to focus on operational clarity and reliable matching.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for reading clarity. Strict 12pt (md) gap between cards in lists. Do not use random margins.

do's: Sticky headers when scrolling through loads
Floating Post Load FAB (brandTertiary tint over surfaceSecondary)

screens.name: Auth (Login & Role Selection)
screens.purpose: Secure entry and clear segmentation of Shippers vs Drivers.

states.error: Inline text below inputs or standard alert.

screens.layout: Top-aligned logo or Hero background image with vertical gradient scrim. Segmented control for 'Shipper' vs 'Driver' selection. Email/Password inputs below. Sticky login CTA at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Shipper Home (My Loads)
screens.purpose: Dashboard for shippers to monitor active shipments and post new ones.

states.empty: Illustration of warehouse with 'No active loads. Post a load to get started.' + Primary 'Post Load' CTA.

screens.layout: Organize loads by pickup date/status (Active, Pending). Single-column scrollable list of load cards. Each card displays Origin -> Dest (large text), Date, Weight, and Truck Type. Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored bottom right with glass effect for 'Post Load'.

screens.name: Driver Home (Available Loads)
screens.purpose: Feed of available return loads for drivers to bid on.

states.empty: Illustration of empty trailer with 'No return loads matching your route.'

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontal scrollable filter chips (Truck Type, Origin, Destination, Date). List of Load cards displaying Origin -> Dest, Price/Offer indicator, and Distance. 'My Trips' accessible via bottom tab.

screens.name: Post Load Form (Shipper)
screens.purpose: Comprehensive form for shippers to post freight requirements.

states.error: Form validation errors highlighted in error color.

screens.layout: Single column scrollable form. Labels above inputs. Fields: Pickup, Drop, Date, Weight, Material, Truck Type, Expected Price. Primary 'Post Load' CTA sticky at bottom with safe-area clearance.

screens.name: Load Details & Offers (Shipper/Driver)
screens.purpose: View full load specifications and manage incoming/outgoing bids.

states.empty: Shipper view: 'No offers yet.' Driver view: N/A
states.error: Failed to load details, Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: High-contrast summary (Route, Date, Specs). Middle section: List of offers received/made. Instant bid responses preferred. Bottom: Sticky CTA to 'Accept Offer', 'Counter Offer', or 'Make Offer'.

screens.name: Negotiation Chat
screens.purpose: Direct communication for counter-offers and terms.
screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Timestamped bubbles. Integrated 'System' bubbles for formal counter-offer submissions. Input field sticky at bottom above keyboard.

screens.name: Trip Tracking & OTP (My Trips)
screens.purpose: Track live status of booked shipments and verify via OTP.
screens.layout: Prominent Vertical Status Stepper: Picked Up -> In Transit -> Delivered. Current step pulses (::after animation equivalent in RN). OTP input block visible when approaching pickup or delivery for verification. Load details summarized below.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level moderation of users, loads, and disputes.
screens.layout: Utility-first grid. High-level metric cards (Total Users, Active Loads) at top. List views for Disputes and Verifications. Clear data density.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. The app should feel like a highly functional B2B utility.
Do not use ANY blue hues (indigo, violet, sky, navy, royal). Only use the specified brick red (#B23A22) and sunrise orange (#E65100) alongside neutrals (gray/slate).
Ensure the sticky CTAs ('Post Load', 'Make Offer', etc.) are anchored outside scroll views, with appropriate safe-area padding at the bottom.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' or 'Space Grotesk' for display numbers (prices, weights, dates) to give a sharp, readable data-heavy feel, while using 'Geist' for body text.
Implement a prominent vertical stepper for Trip Tracking. Ensure the active step pulses.
When placing text over the hero image (Auth screen), apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Mock all payments as requested in the MVP. For statuses, stick exactly to 'Picked up / In transit / Delivered' with no live map integration.
For Load Cards, organize by Origin -> Dest prominently, keeping auxiliary data (Weight, Date, Truck Type) clearly aligned in a functional grid.
